items.question: Trong câu "A tree is a data structure made of nodes in a parent / child relationship.", từ "relationship" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A tree is a data structure made of nodes in a parent / child relationship.", what does "relationship" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: relationship /rɪˈleɪ.ʃən.ʃɪp/ (danh từ): mối quan hệ. "Parent / child relationship" = quan hệ cha / con giữa các nút.
items.explanationEn: relationship /rɪˈleɪ.ʃən.ʃɪp/ (noun): a connection between things. "A parent / child relationship" links each node to the node above it.

items.question: Trong câu "One node sits at the top (the root), every other node has exactly one parent, and following child links never leads you back to where you started.", từ "link" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One node sits at the top (the root), every other node has exactly one parent, and following child links never leads you back to where you started.", what does "link" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an address of a web page
items.explanation: link /lɪŋk/ (danh từ): liên kết (giữa hai nút). "Follow a link" = đi theo liên kết; ở đây là con trỏ từ nút cha tới nút con.
items.explanationEn: link /lɪŋk/ (noun): a connection between two nodes. "Follow a link" means moving along the pointer from a parent to a child.

items.question: Trong câu "Break any rule and it is no longer a tree", từ "no longer" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Break any rule and it is no longer a tree", what does "no longer" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: no longer /nəʊ ˈlɒŋ.ɡər/ (cụm từ): không còn nữa. "It is no longer X" = nó không còn là X nữa (trước đây là, giờ thì không).
items.explanationEn: no longer /nəʊ ˈlɒŋ.ɡər/ (phrase): not any more. "It is no longer X" means it used to be X but is not any more.

items.question: Trong câu "In the first picture the extra edge 9–12 creates a cycle (2 → 9 → 12 → 2).", từ "cycle" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In the first picture the extra edge 9–12 creates a cycle (2 → 9 → 12 → 2).", what does "cycle" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: cycle /ˈsaɪ.kəl/ (danh từ): chu trình (vòng khép kín). Trong đồ thị, "cycle" là đường đi quay về nút xuất phát; cây không có cycle.
items.explanationEn: cycle /ˈsaɪ.kəl/ (noun): a closed loop of links. In a graph, a cycle is a path that returns to its start; trees have none.

items.question: Trong câu "Some people count height in nodes (this tree would be 3); just say which convention you use.", từ "convention" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Some people count height in nodes (this tree would be 3); just say which convention you use.", what does "convention" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a change from one form to another
an agreed way of doing something
items.explanation: convention /kənˈven.ʃən/ (danh từ): quy ước. "Naming convention" = quy ước đặt tên; "by convention" = theo quy ước.
items.explanationEn: convention /kənˈven.ʃən/ (noun): an agreed way of doing something. "Naming convention" and "by convention" are common collocations.

items.question: Trong câu "Arrays, linked lists, stacks and queues are linear", từ "linear" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Arrays, linked lists, stacks and queues are linear", what does "linear" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: linear /ˈlɪn.i.ər/ (tính từ): tuyến tính (xếp thành một hàng). "Linear data structure" = cấu trúc dữ liệu tuyến tính; "linear time" = thời gian O(n).
items.explanationEn: linear /ˈlɪn.i.ər/ (adjective): arranged in a single line. "Linear data structure"; also "linear time" meaning O(n).

items.question: Trong câu "Trees are non-linear: a node can branch to many children.", từ "branch" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Trees are non-linear: a node can branch to many children.", what does "branch" (verb) mean?
options: rẽ nhánh, tách ra nhiều hướng
optionsEn: a local office of a company
items.explanation: branch /brɑːntʃ/ (động từ): rẽ nhánh, tách ra nhiều hướng. "Branch" (động từ) = rẽ nhánh; danh từ "branch" còn nghĩa là cành cây hoặc chi nhánh.
items.explanationEn: branch /brɑːntʃ/ (verb): to split into several paths. As a verb, "branch" means to split; the noun also means a tree limb or an office.

items.question: Trong câu "A singly linked list (2 -> 12 -> 11) is really a degenerate tree where every node has at most one child.", từ "degenerate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A singly linked list (2 -> 12 -> 11) is really a degenerate tree where every node has at most one child.", what does "degenerate" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: reduced to a simpler, poor form
items.explanation: degenerate /dɪˈdʒen.ər.ət/ (tính từ): suy biến (mất hình dạng chuẩn). "Degenerate tree" = cây suy biến, thực chất là một danh sách liên kết.
items.explanationEn: degenerate /dɪˈdʒen.ər.ət/ (adjective): reduced to a simpler, poor form. A "degenerate tree" has collapsed into what is really a linked list.

items.question: Trong câu "Keep that in mind — it is exactly what a badly shaped BST turns into (section 9).", từ "keep in mind" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Keep that in mind — it is exactly what a badly shaped BST turns into (section 9).", what does "keep in mind" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: keep in mind /kiːp ɪn maɪnd/ (cụm từ): ghi nhớ, lưu ý. "Keep (something) in mind" = hãy nhớ điều đó để dùng về sau.
items.explanationEn: keep in mind /kiːp ɪn maɪnd/ (phrase): to remember and consider. "Keep something in mind" means remember it because it will matter later.

items.question: Trong câu "Keep that in mind — it is exactly what a badly shaped BST turns into (section 9).", từ "turn into" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Keep that in mind — it is exactly what a badly shaped BST turns into (section 9).", what does "turn into" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: turn into /tɜːn ˈɪn.tuː/ (cụm từ): biến thành. "A turns into B" = A trở thành B; BST xấu biến thành danh sách liên kết.
items.explanationEn: turn into /tɜːn ˈɪn.tuː/ (phrase): to become. "A turns into B" means A becomes B; a badly shaped BST becomes a list.

items.question: Trong câu "Trees model anything hierarchical", từ "hierarchical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Trees model anything hierarchical", what does "hierarchical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: hierarchical /ˌhaɪəˈrɑː.kɪ.kəl/ (tính từ): phân cấp, theo tầng bậc. "Hierarchical data" = dữ liệu phân cấp, như thư mục lồng thư mục.
items.explanationEn: hierarchical /ˌhaɪəˈrɑː.kɪ.kəl/ (adjective): organised in levels. "Hierarchical data", like folders inside folders, fits a tree.

items.question: Trong câu "Trees model anything hierarchical", từ "model" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Trees model anything hierarchical", what does "model" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to work as a fashion model
items.explanation: model /ˈmɒd.əl/ (động từ): mô phỏng, biểu diễn. "X models Y" = X dùng để biểu diễn Y; danh từ "model" còn là người mẫu.
items.explanationEn: model /ˈmɒd.əl/ (verb): to represent something. "X models Y" means X is used to represent Y; the noun also means a fashion model.

items.question: Trong câu "A binary tree is a tree in which every node has at most two children, called left and right.", từ "at most" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A binary tree is a tree in which every node has at most two children, called left and right.", what does "at most" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at most /ət məʊst/ (cụm từ): nhiều nhất, tối đa. "At most two" = tối đa hai; ngược lại là "at least" (ít nhất).
items.explanationEn: at most /ət məʊst/ (phrase): no more than. "At most two" means two or fewer; the opposite is "at least".

items.question: Trong câu "Level d holds at most 2^d nodes (1, 2, 4, 8, …).", từ "hold" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Level d holds at most 2^d nodes (1, 2, 4, 8, …).", what does "hold" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: hold /həʊld/ (động từ): chứa, chứa được. "A level holds N nodes" = một tầng chứa được N nút; "hold" có nhiều nghĩa khác.
items.explanationEn: hold /həʊld/ (verb): to contain. "A level holds N nodes" means it contains them; "hold" has many other senses.

items.question: Trong câu "So n nodes need a height of at least ⌊log₂ n⌋ — and can have a height of at most n − 1 (a chain).", từ "chain" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "So n nodes need a height of at least ⌊log₂ n⌋ — and can have a height of at most n − 1 (a chain).", what does "chain" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: chain /tʃeɪn/ (danh từ): chuỗi nối tiếp nhau. "A chain" ở đây = các nút nối thành một hàng dài; cũng dùng "chain of calls".
items.explanationEn: chain /tʃeɪn/ (noun): a line of linked items. Here "a chain" is nodes linked in one long line; compare "a chain of calls".

items.question: Trong câu "Those two bounds, log n and n, are the whole story of BST performance.", từ "bound" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Those two bounds, log n and n, are the whole story of BST performance.", what does "bound" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: bound /baʊnd/ (danh từ): giới hạn, cận. "Upper bound / lower bound" = cận trên / cận dưới.
items.explanationEn: bound /baʊnd/ (noun): a limit. "Upper bound" and "lower bound" are the usual collocations.

items.question: Trong câu "A binary search tree (BST) is a binary tree that keeps its values in order", từ "in order" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A binary search tree (BST) is a binary tree that keeps its values in order", what does "in order" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in order /ɪn ˈɔː.dər/ (cụm từ): theo thứ tự. "Keep values in order" = giữ giá trị theo thứ tự; khác "in order to" (để).
items.explanationEn: in order /ɪn ˈɔː.dər/ (phrase): sorted, arranged in sequence. "Keep values in order" means sorted; do not confuse with "in order to".

items.question: Trong câu "The rule applies to the whole subtree, not just the direct children.", từ "apply" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The rule applies to the whole subtree, not just the direct children.", what does "apply" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: apply /əˈplaɪ/ (động từ): áp dụng cho. "The rule applies to X" = quy tắc có hiệu lực với X; "apply for a job" = nộp đơn.
items.explanationEn: apply /əˈplaɪ/ (verb): to be relevant to. "The rule applies to X" means it covers X; "apply for a job" is a different sense.

items.question: Trong câu "Because of the property, every comparison throws away one whole subtree", từ "property" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Because of the property, every comparison throws away one whole subtree", what does "property" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: property /ˈprɒp.ə.ti/ (danh từ): tính chất, đặc tính. "The BST property" = tính chất BST (trái nhỏ hơn, phải lớn hơn).
items.explanationEn: property /ˈprɒp.ə.ti/ (noun): a defining feature. "The BST property" is the rule that left is smaller and right is larger.

items.question: Trong câu "Because of the property, every comparison throws away one whole subtree", từ "throw away" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Because of the property, every comparison throws away one whole subtree", what does "throw away" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: throw away /θrəʊ əˈweɪ/ (cụm từ): loại bỏ, gạt đi. "Throw away half the search space" = loại bỏ một nửa không gian tìm kiếm.
items.explanationEn: throw away /θrəʊ əˈweɪ/ (phrase): to discard. "Throw away half the search space" is typical of binary search.

items.question: Trong câu "Visiting a BST left-subtree → node → right-subtree yields the values in sorted order (that traversal, in-order DFS, is covered in the next topic).", từ "yield" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Visiting a BST left-subtree → node → right-subtree yields the values in sorted order (that traversal, in-order DFS, is covered in the next topic).", what does "yield" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: yield /jiːld/ (động từ): cho ra, tạo ra. "X yields Y" = X cho ra kết quả Y; "yield" còn nghĩa là nhường, đầu hàng.
items.explanationEn: yield /jiːld/ (verb): to produce. "X yields Y" means X produces Y; "yield" can also mean give way.

items.question: Trong câu "Visiting a BST left-subtree → node → right-subtree yields the values in sorted order (that traversal, in-order DFS, is covered in the next topic).", từ "traversal" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Visiting a BST left-subtree → node → right-subtree yields the values in sorted order (that traversal, in-order DFS, is covered in the next topic).", what does "traversal" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: traversal /trəˈvɜː.səl/ (danh từ): phép duyệt (đi qua mọi nút). "Tree traversal" = duyệt cây; động từ là "traverse".
items.explanationEn: traversal /trəˈvɜː.səl/ (noun): a visit of every node. "Tree traversal" is the noun; the verb is "traverse".

items.question: Trong câu "Duplicates need a policy.", từ "duplicate" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Duplicates need a policy.", what does "duplicate" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: duplicate /ˈdjuː.plɪ.kət/ (danh từ): giá trị trùng lặp. "Remove duplicates" = loại bỏ phần tử trùng; động từ "duplicate" /-keɪt/ = sao chép.
items.explanationEn: duplicate /ˈdjuː.plɪ.kət/ (noun): a repeated copy. "Remove duplicates" is common; the verb "duplicate" is pronounced /-keɪt/.

items.question: Trong câu "Duplicates need a policy.", từ "policy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Duplicates need a policy.", what does "policy" (noun) mean?
options: cách xử lý đã quy định
items.explanation: policy /ˈpɒl.ə.si/ (danh từ): cách xử lý đã quy định. "A policy for duplicates" = quy tắc xử lý giá trị trùng; "retry policy" cũng hay gặp.
items.explanationEn: policy /ˈpɒl.ə.si/ (noun): an agreed rule for handling. "A policy for duplicates" is a rule for handling them; compare "retry policy".

items.question: Trong câu "Common choices: ignore them (what we do here), store a count on the node, or consistently send equal values to one side (e.g. <= goes left).", từ "consistently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Common choices: ignore them (what we do here), store a count on the node, or consistently send equal values to one side (e.g. <= goes left).", what does "consistently" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: consistently /kənˈsɪs.tənt.li/ (trạng từ): một cách nhất quán. "Consistently" = luôn làm theo cùng một cách; tính từ là "consistent".
items.explanationEn: consistently /kənˈsɪs.tənt.li/ (adverb): always in the same way. "Consistently" means always the same way; the adjective is "consistent".

items.question: Trong câu "A BST is just nodes pointing to nodes, plus a reference to the root:", từ "reference" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A BST is just nodes pointing to nodes, plus a reference to the root:", what does "reference" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a source to look things up
items.explanation: reference /ˈref.ər.əns/ (danh từ): tham chiếu (trỏ tới đối tượng). "Hold a reference to X" = giữ tham chiếu tới X.
items.explanationEn: reference /ˈref.ər.əns/ (noun): a pointer to an object. "Hold a reference to X" means keep a pointer to X.

items.question: Trong câu "You could wire nodes by hand (tree.root.left = new Node(6)), but nothing would stop you putting 20 on the left.", từ "by hand" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You could wire nodes by hand (tree.root.left = new Node(6)), but nothing would stop you putting 20 on the left.", what does "by hand" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: by hand /baɪ hænd/ (cụm từ): thủ công, tự làm tay. "Do something by hand" = làm thủ công, không dùng công cụ hay hàm tự động.
items.explanationEn: by hand /baɪ hænd/ (phrase): manually. "Do something by hand" means manually, without a helper or tool.

items.question: Trong câu "insert enforces the BST property for you.", từ "enforce" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "insert enforces the BST property for you.", what does "enforce" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to make sure a rule is obeyed
items.explanation: enforce /ɪnˈfɔːs/ (động từ): đảm bảo tuân thủ. "Enforce a rule / constraint" = bắt buộc quy tắc được tuân theo.
items.explanationEn: enforce /ɪnˈfɔːs/ (verb): to make sure a rule is obeyed. "Enforce a rule" or "enforce a constraint" are common collocations.

items.question: Trong câu "Space O(1) iterative, O(h) recursive (call stack).", từ "iterative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Space O(1) iterative, O(h) recursive (call stack).", what does "iterative" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: iterative /ˈɪt.ər.ə.tɪv/ (tính từ): dùng vòng lặp. "Iterative version" = phiên bản dùng vòng lặp; đối lập với "recursive".
items.explanationEn: iterative /ˈɪt.ər.ə.tɪv/ (adjective): using a loop. "The iterative version" uses a loop, as opposed to "recursive".

items.question: Trong câu "Space O(1) iterative, O(h) recursive (call stack).", từ "recursive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Space O(1) iterative, O(h) recursive (call stack).", what does "recursive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: recursive /rɪˈkɜː.sɪv/ (tính từ): đệ quy (hàm tự gọi lại). "Recursive call" = lời gọi đệ quy; mỗi lời gọi chiếm một khung trên call stack.
items.explanationEn: recursive /rɪˈkɜː.sɪv/ (adjective): calling itself. Each "recursive call" takes a frame on the call stack.

items.question: Trong câu "If that side is empty, attach the new node there.", từ "attach" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If that side is empty, attach the new node there.", what does "attach" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to add a file to an email
items.explanation: attach /əˈtætʃ/ (động từ): gắn vào. "Attach X to Y" = gắn X vào Y; trong email là "đính kèm".
items.explanationEn: attach /əˈtætʃ/ (verb): to join to something. "Attach X to Y" means join X to Y; with email it means add a file.

items.question: Trong câu "Otherwise start at the root and compare: greater → go right, less → go left.", từ "otherwise" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Otherwise start at the root and compare: greater → go right, less → go left.", what does "otherwise" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: otherwise /ˈʌð.ə.waɪz/ (trạng từ): nếu không thì. "Otherwise" = nếu điều kiện trước không đúng thì…, giống nhánh "else".
items.explanationEn: otherwise /ˈʌð.ə.waɪz/ (adverb): if not. "Otherwise" introduces what happens if the previous condition fails, like "else".

items.question: Trong câu "The recursive version returns the (possibly new) subtree root and assigns it back to the parent's pointer:", từ "assign" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The recursive version returns the (possibly new) subtree root and assigns it back to the parent's pointer:", what does "assign" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to store a value in a variable
items.explanation: assign /əˈsaɪn/ (động từ): gán (giá trị cho biến). "Assign X to Y" = gán X cho Y; danh từ là "assignment".
items.explanationEn: assign /əˈsaɪn/ (verb): to store a value in a variable. "Assign X to Y" stores X in Y; the noun is "assignment".

items.question: Trong câu "The recursive version returns the (possibly new) subtree root and assigns it back to the parent's pointer:", từ "pointer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The recursive version returns the (possibly new) subtree root and assigns it back to the parent's pointer:", what does "pointer" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pointer /ˈpɔɪn.tər/ (danh từ): con trỏ (tới nút khác). "Parent's pointer" = con trỏ left/right của nút cha; "pointer" còn nghĩa là mẹo nhỏ.
items.explanationEn: pointer /ˈpɔɪn.tər/ (noun): a link to another node. "The parent's pointer" is its left or right link; "pointer" can also mean a tip.

items.question: Trong câu "Forgetting the assignment (insertNode(node.left, value); on its own) is a classic bug: the new node is created and immediately lost.", từ "classic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Forgetting the assignment (insertNode(node.left, value); on its own) is a classic bug: the new node is created and immediately lost.", what does "classic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: classic /ˈklæs.ɪk/ (tính từ): điển hình, kinh điển. "A classic bug / mistake" = lỗi kinh điển mà ai cũng từng mắc.
items.explanationEn: classic /ˈklæs.ɪk/ (adjective): typical and well known. "A classic bug" or "a classic mistake" is one almost everyone makes.

items.question: Trong câu "Forgetting the assignment (insertNode(node.left, value); on its own) is a classic bug: the new node is created and immediately lost.", từ "immediately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Forgetting the assignment (insertNode(node.left, value); on its own) is a classic bug: the new node is created and immediately lost.", what does "immediately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: immediately /ɪˈmiː.di.ət.li/ (trạng từ): ngay lập tức. "Immediately" = ngay lập tức; hay gặp "immediately after" (ngay sau khi).
items.explanationEn: immediately /ɪˈmiː.di.ət.li/ (adverb): at once. "Immediately" means at once; compare "immediately after".

items.question: Trong câu "Complexity: time O(h), where h is the tree height — one comparison per level.", từ "complexity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Complexity: time O(h), where h is the tree height — one comparison per level.", what does "complexity" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the cost in time or space
items.explanation: complexity /kəmˈplek.sə.ti/ (danh từ): độ phức tạp (thời gian/bộ nhớ). "Time / space complexity" = độ phức tạp thời gian / bộ nhớ, viết bằng Big O.
items.explanationEn: complexity /kəmˈplek.sə.ti/ (noun): the cost in time or space. "Time complexity" and "space complexity" are written in Big O.

items.question: Trong câu "Search follows exactly the same path as insert, but stops when it finds the value or falls off the tree:", từ "fall off" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Search follows exactly the same path as insert, but stops when it finds the value or falls off the tree:", what does "fall off" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: fall off /fɔːl ɒf/ (cụm từ): đi ra ngoài (gặp null). "Fall off the tree" = đi quá nút lá tới null; "fall off" còn nghĩa là giảm sút.
items.explanationEn: fall off /fɔːl ɒf/ (phrase): to go past the end. "Fall off the tree" means stepping past a leaf to null; it can also mean decline.

items.question: Trong câu "max() is the mirror image, following right.", từ "mirror image" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "max() is the mirror image, following right.", what does "mirror image" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: mirror image /ˈmɪr.ər ˈɪm.ɪdʒ/ (cụm từ): bản đối xứng, ngược chiều. "X is the mirror image of Y" = X giống Y nhưng đảo chiều (trái thành phải).
items.explanationEn: mirror image /ˈmɪr.ər ˈɪm.ɪdʒ/ (phrase): the reversed version. "X is the mirror image of Y" means the same but reversed left to right.

items.question: Trong câu "In a well-balanced tree, doubling the number of nodes adds only one level: 15 nodes fit in 4 levels, 1,023 in 10, about a million in 20.", từ "double" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In a well-balanced tree, doubling the number of nodes adds only one level: 15 nodes fit in 4 levels, 1,023 in 10, about a million in 20.", what does "double" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: double /ˈdʌb.əl/ (động từ): tăng gấp đôi. "Doubling the input" = tăng gấp đôi đầu vào; đối lập "halving" (giảm một nửa).
items.explanationEn: double /ˈdʌb.əl/ (verb): to make twice as large. "Doubling the input" is the opposite of "halving" it.

items.question: Trong câu "A self-balancing BST does a little extra work on insert and remove to keep the height at O(log n), turning the average case into a guarantee.", từ "guarantee" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A self-balancing BST does a little extra work on insert and remove to keep the height at O(log n), turning the average case into a guarantee.", what does "guarantee" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: guarantee /ˌɡær.ənˈtiː/ (danh từ): sự đảm bảo chắc chắn. "A guarantee" = điều chắc chắn xảy ra; động từ "be guaranteed" = được đảm bảo.
items.explanationEn: guarantee /ˌɡær.ənˈtiː/ (noun): a firm promise. "A guarantee" is something certain; the verb form is "be guaranteed".

items.question: Trong câu "With random insertion order the average node depth is about 1.39 log₂ n, so plain BSTs behave well on random data.", từ "plain" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With random insertion order the average node depth is about 1.39 log₂ n, so plain BSTs behave well on random data.", what does "plain" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: plain /pleɪn/ (tính từ): thông thường, không thêm gì. "Plain BST" = BST cơ bản, không tự cân bằng; "plain text" = văn bản thuần.
items.explanationEn: plain /pleɪn/ (adjective): basic, with no extras. "A plain BST" has no self-balancing; compare "plain text".

items.question: Trong câu "With random insertion order the average node depth is about 1.39 log₂ n, so plain BSTs behave well on random data.", từ "behave" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With random insertion order the average node depth is about 1.39 log₂ n, so plain BSTs behave well on random data.", what does "behave" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: behave /bɪˈheɪv/ (động từ): hoạt động, vận hành. "Behave well on X" = chạy tốt với X; danh từ "behaviour" = hành vi.
items.explanationEn: behave /bɪˈheɪv/ (verb): to perform or work. "Behave well on X" means perform well with X; the noun is "behaviour".

items.question: Trong câu "Real data is often sorted or nearly sorted (IDs, timestamps), which is exactly the worst case.", từ "nearly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Real data is often sorted or nearly sorted (IDs, timestamps), which is exactly the worst case.", what does "nearly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: nearly /ˈnɪə.li/ (trạng từ): gần như. "Nearly sorted" = gần như đã sắp xếp; đừng nhầm với "near" (ở gần).
items.explanationEn: nearly /ˈnɪə.li/ (adverb): almost. "Nearly sorted" means almost sorted; do not confuse with "near".

items.question: Trong câu "Real data is often sorted or nearly sorted (IDs, timestamps), which is exactly the worst case.", từ "worst case" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Real data is often sorted or nearly sorted (IDs, timestamps), which is exactly the worst case.", what does "worst case" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: worst case /wɜːst keɪs/ (cụm từ): trường hợp xấu nhất. "Worst case / best case / average case" = xấu nhất / tốt nhất / trung bình.
items.explanationEn: worst case /wɜːst keɪs/ (phrase): the least favourable situation. "Worst case", "best case" and "average case" describe input scenarios.

items.question: Trong câu "The fix is a tree that keeps itself balanced.", từ "balanced" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The fix is a tree that keeps itself balanced.", what does "balanced" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: balanced /ˈbæl.ənst/ (tính từ): cân bằng (hai bên đều nhau). "Balanced tree" = cây cân bằng, chiều cao O(log n).
items.explanationEn: balanced /ˈbæl.ənst/ (adjective): even on both sides. A "balanced tree" keeps its height at O(log n).

items.question: Trong câu "The tool is a rotation: an O(1) pointer rearrangement that changes the shape but keeps the BST order.", từ "rotation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The tool is a rotation: an O(1) pointer rearrangement that changes the shape but keeps the BST order.", what does "rotation" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a turn that reshapes a tree
items.explanation: rotation /rəʊˈteɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): phép xoay (đổi hình cây). "Left / right rotation" = phép xoay trái / phải trong cây AVL, đỏ-đen.
items.explanationEn: rotation /rəʊˈteɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a turn that reshapes a tree. "Left rotation" and "right rotation" are used in AVL and red-black trees.

items.question: Trong câu "The tool is a rotation: an O(1) pointer rearrangement that changes the shape but keeps the BST order.", từ "rearrangement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The tool is a rotation: an O(1) pointer rearrangement that changes the shape but keeps the BST order.", what does "rearrangement" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: rearrangement /ˌriː.əˈreɪndʒ.mənt/ (danh từ): sự sắp xếp lại. "Pointer rearrangement" = đổi chỗ các con trỏ; động từ là "rearrange".
items.explanationEn: rearrangement /ˌriː.əˈreɪndʒ.mənt/ (noun): a change of positions. "Pointer rearrangement" changes links; the verb is "rearrange".

items.question: Trong câu "You are rarely asked to code AVL or red-black rotations in an interview, but you are expected to know they exist and what they guarantee.", từ "rarely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You are rarely asked to code AVL or red-black rotations in an interview, but you are expected to know they exist and what they guarantee.", what does "rarely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: rarely /ˈreə.li/ (trạng từ): hiếm khi. "Rarely" = hiếm khi, thường đứng trước động từ chính: "are rarely asked".
items.explanationEn: rarely /ˈreə.li/ (adverb): not often. "Rarely" usually sits before the main verb: "are rarely asked".

items.question: Trong câu "JavaScript has no built-in sorted map, so you either use a library or an alternative.", từ "built-in" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "JavaScript has no built-in sorted map, so you either use a library or an alternative.", what does "built-in" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: built-in /ˌbɪltˈɪn/ (tính từ): có sẵn (tích hợp). "Built-in function / type" = hàm / kiểu có sẵn trong ngôn ngữ.
items.explanationEn: built-in /ˌbɪltˈɪn/ (adjective): included by default. "Built-in function" or "built-in type" comes with the language.

items.question: Trong câu "JavaScript has no built-in sorted map, so you either use a library or an alternative.", từ "alternative" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "JavaScript has no built-in sorted map, so you either use a library or an alternative.", what does "alternative" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: alternative /ɔːlˈtɜː.nə.tɪv/ (danh từ): giải pháp thay thế. "An alternative to X" = một lựa chọn thay cho X.
items.explanationEn: alternative /ɔːlˈtɜː.nə.tɪv/ (noun): another option. "An alternative to X" is another option instead of X.

items.question: Trong câu "A related trick: from a sorted array you can build a perfectly balanced BST in O(n) by making the middle element the root and recursing on each half.", từ "trick" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A related trick: from a sorted array you can build a perfectly balanced BST in O(n) by making the middle element the root and recursing on each half.", what does "trick" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: trick /trɪk/ (danh từ): mẹo, kỹ thuật khéo. "A neat trick" = một mẹo hay; "trick" cũng có nghĩa là trò lừa.
items.explanationEn: trick /trɪk/ (noun): a clever technique. "A neat trick" is a clever technique; "trick" can also mean a deception.

items.question: Trong câu "Choose a BST when you need order (sorted iteration, floor/ceiling, ranges) and frequent inserts and deletes.", từ "frequent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Choose a BST when you need order (sorted iteration, floor/ceiling, ranges) and frequent inserts and deletes.", what does "frequent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: frequent /ˈfriː.kwənt/ (tính từ): thường xuyên. "Frequent inserts" = chèn thường xuyên; danh từ "frequency" = tần suất.
items.explanationEn: frequent /ˈfriː.kwənt/ (adjective): happening often. "Frequent inserts" happen often; the noun is "frequency".

items.question: Trong câu "Removal is the trickiest operation because the tree must stay a valid BST.", từ "tricky" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Removal is the trickiest operation because the tree must stay a valid BST.", what does "tricky" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: difficult and easy to get wrong
items.explanation: tricky /ˈtrɪk.i/ (tính từ): khó, dễ sai. "The trickiest part" = phần khó nhất, dễ mắc lỗi nhất.
items.explanationEn: tricky /ˈtrɪk.i/ (adjective): difficult and easy to get wrong. "The trickiest part" is the one most likely to go wrong.

items.question: Trong câu "Removal is the trickiest operation because the tree must stay a valid BST.", từ "valid" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Removal is the trickiest operation because the tree must stay a valid BST.", what does "valid" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: valid /ˈvæl.ɪd/ (tính từ): hợp lệ. "A valid BST" = BST hợp lệ; đối lập "invalid".
items.explanationEn: valid /ˈvæl.ɪd/ (adjective): meeting the rules. "A valid BST" follows the rules; the opposite is "invalid".

items.question: Trong câu "Case 1 — leaf (0 children): just cut it off (point its parent at null).", từ "cut off" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Case 1 — leaf (0 children): just cut it off (point its parent at null).", what does "cut off" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: cut off /kʌt ɒf/ (cụm từ): cắt bỏ, tách ra. "Cut it off" = cắt bỏ nút lá khỏi cây; "cut off" còn là ngắt lời, cắt nguồn.
items.explanationEn: cut off /kʌt ɒf/ (phrase): to remove by cutting. "Cut it off" removes the leaf; "cut off" can also mean interrupt.

items.question: Trong câu "Case 3 — two children: you cannot splice it out.", từ "splice" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Case 3 — two children: you cannot splice it out.", what does "splice" (verb) mean?
options: tách ra và nối hai đầu lại
optionsEn: to remove and join the ends
items.explanation: splice /splaɪs/ (động từ): tách ra và nối hai đầu lại. "Splice out" = gỡ nút ra rồi nối cha với con của nó; JS có Array.splice.
items.explanationEn: splice /splaɪs/ (verb): to remove and join the ends. "Splice out" removes a node and links its parent to its child; compare Array.splice.

items.question: Trong câu "Replace its value with its in-order successor — the smallest value in its right subtree (go right once, then left all the way) — and then remove that successor, which has at most one child.", từ "successor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Replace its value with its in-order successor — the smallest value in its right subtree (go right once, then left all the way) — and then remove that successor, which has at most one child.", what does "successor" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a person who takes over a role
items.explanation: successor /səkˈses.ər/ (danh từ): phần tử kế tiếp. "In-order successor" = nút kế tiếp theo thứ tự; đối lập "predecessor".
items.explanationEn: successor /səkˈses.ər/ (noun): the next item in order. "In-order successor" is the next node in sorted order; the opposite is "predecessor".

items.question: Trong câu "The in-order predecessor (largest in the left subtree) works equally well.", từ "predecessor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The in-order predecessor (largest in the left subtree) works equally well.", what does "predecessor" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a person who held a role before
items.explanation: predecessor /ˈpriː.dɪ.ses.ər/ (danh từ): phần tử liền trước. "In-order predecessor" = nút đứng ngay trước theo thứ tự (lớn nhất cây con trái).
items.explanationEn: predecessor /ˈpriː.dɪ.ses.ər/ (noun): the previous item in order. "In-order predecessor" is the largest value in the left subtree.

items.question: Trong câu "The in-order predecessor (largest in the left subtree) works equally well.", từ "equally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The in-order predecessor (largest in the left subtree) works equally well.", what does "equally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: equally /ˈiː.kwə.li/ (trạng từ): như nhau, ngang bằng. "Work equally well" = hiệu quả như nhau.
items.explanationEn: equally /ˈiː.kwə.li/ (adverb): to the same degree. "Work equally well" means work just as well.

items.question: Trong câu "Note how case 1 is handled for free: a leaf has left === null, so it returns node.right, which is null.", từ "handle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Note how case 1 is handled for free: a leaf has left === null, so it returns node.right, which is null.", what does "handle" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: handle /ˈhæn.dəl/ (động từ): xử lý. "Handle a case / an error" = xử lý một trường hợp / một lỗi.
items.explanationEn: handle /ˈhæn.dəl/ (verb): to deal with. "Handle a case" or "handle an error" means deal with it.

items.question: Trong câu "Note how case 1 is handled for free: a leaf has left === null, so it returns node.right, which is null.", từ "for free" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Note how case 1 is handled for free: a leaf has left === null, so it returns node.right, which is null.", what does "for free" (phrase) mean?
options: tự nhiên có, không cần thêm gì
items.explanation: for free /fə friː/ (cụm từ): tự nhiên có, không cần thêm gì. "Get X for free" trong lập trình = có X mà không cần viết thêm code.
items.explanationEn: for free /fə friː/ (phrase): with no extra effort. In code, "get X for free" means X works with no extra code.

items.question: Trong câu "is a favourite interview question, and the naive answer is wrong", từ "naive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "is a favourite interview question, and the naive answer is wrong", what does "naive" (adjective) mean?
options: ngây thơ, đơn giản quá mức
items.explanation: naive /naɪˈiːv/ (tính từ): ngây thơ, đơn giản quá mức. "Naive approach / solution" = cách làm đơn giản nhưng thiếu sót hoặc chậm.
items.explanationEn: naive /naɪˈiːv/ (adjective): too simple, missing details. "A naive approach" is simple but flawed or slow.

items.question: Trong câu "It accepts the invalid tree from section 5 (12 below 6 on the left of 10), because every parent/child pair looks fine locally.", từ "locally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It accepts the invalid tree from section 5 (12 below 6 on the left of 10), because every parent/child pair looks fine locally.", what does "locally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: locally /ˈləʊ.kəl.i/ (trạng từ): xét cục bộ (từng phần nhỏ). "Fine locally" = đúng khi chỉ xét cặp cha/con, nhưng sai trên toàn cây.
items.explanationEn: locally /ˈləʊ.kəl.i/ (adverb): within a small part only. "Fine locally" means correct for each pair but wrong for the whole tree.

items.question: Trong câu "The correct version passes down the allowed range for each subtree:", từ "pass down" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The correct version passes down the allowed range for each subtree:", what does "pass down" (phrase) mean?
options: truyền lại cho thế hệ sau
optionsEn: to hand to the next generation
to give to a lower level
items.explanation: pass down /pɑːs daʊn/ (cụm từ): truyền xuống (cho lời gọi con). "Pass down X" = truyền X xuống các lời gọi đệ quy bên dưới.
items.explanationEn: pass down /pɑːs daʊn/ (phrase): to give to a lower level. "Pass down X" means give X to the recursive calls below.

items.question: Trong câu "The correct version passes down the allowed range for each subtree:", từ "range" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The correct version passes down the allowed range for each subtree:", what does "range" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: range /reɪndʒ/ (danh từ): khoảng giá trị. "Allowed range" = khoảng giá trị cho phép, ví dụ (6, 10).
items.explanationEn: range /reɪndʒ/ (noun): a span between limits. "Allowed range" is the span of permitted values, e.g. (6, 10).

items.question: Trong câu "A tree is connected, acyclic, one root, every other node has one parent; n nodes → n − 1 edges.", từ "acyclic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A tree is connected, acyclic, one root, every other node has one parent; n nodes → n − 1 edges.", what does "acyclic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: acyclic /eɪˈsaɪ.klɪk/ (tính từ): không có chu trình. "Acyclic graph" = đồ thị không chu trình; tiền tố "a-" nghĩa là "không".
items.explanationEn: acyclic /eɪˈsaɪ.klɪk/ (adjective): having no cycles. "Acyclic graph" has no cycles; the prefix "a-" means "not".

items.question: Trong câu "BST = binary tree where the entire left subtree is smaller and the entire right subtree is larger.", từ "entire" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BST = binary tree where the entire left subtree is smaller and the entire right subtree is larger.", what does "entire" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: entire /ɪnˈtaɪər/ (tính từ): toàn bộ. "The entire subtree" = toàn bộ cây con, không chỉ con trực tiếp.
items.explanationEn: entire /ɪnˈtaɪər/ (adjective): whole. "The entire subtree" means all of it, not just the direct children.

items.question: Trong câu "Validate with min/max bounds, not just parent/child comparisons.", từ "validate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Validate with min/max bounds, not just parent/child comparisons.", what does "validate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: validate /ˈvæl.ɪ.deɪt/ (động từ): kiểm tra tính hợp lệ. "Validate input / a BST" = kiểm tra xem dữ liệu có hợp lệ không.
items.explanationEn: validate /ˈvæl.ɪ.deɪt/ (verb): to check correctness. "Validate input" or "validate a BST" means check it is correct.

items.question: Trong câu "Performance depends on shape: balanced O(log n), degenerate O(n); self-balancing trees make O(log n) a guarantee.", từ "depend on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Performance depends on shape: balanced O(log n), degenerate O(n); self-balancing trees make O(log n) a guarantee.", what does "depend on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: depend on /dɪˈpend ɒn/ (cụm từ): phụ thuộc vào. "X depends on Y" = X thay đổi theo Y.
items.explanationEn: depend on /dɪˈpend ɒn/ (phrase): to be decided by. "X depends on Y" means X changes with Y.

items.question: Trong câu "The BST ordering lets each comparison discard a whole subtree.", từ "discard" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BST ordering lets each comparison discard a whole subtree.", what does "discard" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: discard /dɪˈskɑːd/ (động từ): loại bỏ. "Discard half the data" = bỏ đi một nửa dữ liệu không cần xét.
items.explanationEn: discard /dɪˈskɑːd/ (verb): to throw away. "Discard half the data" means stop considering it.
